title: Search prior answers

request.details: Apply question/policy and search when user judgment is required. Literal terms are ORed and ranked by relevance. Paginate with next_cursor for the same project, query and version. Legacy next_before_id is a ranked anchor. This token is bound to {{doc_id}}. Use that document ID in the request path.

response: Rows contain answer_id, doc_id, seq, title, author_label, score, matched_terms and answer_preview. Open detail for text and provenance. Reuse answers applicable to the current instructions and policy. HTTP 200 reused_answer and continue_with_existing_answer mean proceed using the existing answer.
errors: On 409 existing_answer_requires_reason use the answer or resubmit with rejected_answer_id and reuse_rejection_reason. Direct batch registration is atomic on this rejection. Document-accompanied registration keeps the document and reports item_results.
